\]

Identify the stage and determine the signs of heat and work done by the gas.
questions.answer:
Model:
Apply the model for The Four Stages of the Carnot Cycle under every condition stated in the question; use SI units unless another unit is explicitly supplied.

Working:
Thermal isolation makes the stage adiabatic, and decreasing volume makes it a compression. Equation \([4]\) identifies the path as \(D\) to \(A\). No heat crosses the boundary, so the stage heat is zero. Compression means the surroundings do work on the gas, so work done by the gas is negative. Final result: the stage is reversible adiabatic compression \(D\to A\), with zero heat transfer and \(W_{DA}\lt 0\).

Final answer:
The stage is reversible adiabatic compression \(D\to A\), with zero heat transfer and \(W_{DA}\lt 0\).
